# How SmartHelio Helped Daystar Power Detect Faults Faster and Improve Solar Performance


Daystar Power operates solar plants across **Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, South Africa, and Egypt** . As the portfolio grew, manually identifying and resolving faults became increasingly difficult.


SmartHelio’s Autopilot helped automate fault detection, shorten resolution times, and turn plant data into actionable operational insights.


### The result?


**4× faster fault resolution, 10% higher solar asset performance, and 8% increased portfolio production.**


[Get the case study](https://share-eu1.hsforms.com/1XQKy7juTShysLlXZGOjWlwewpai)


## In a nutshell


- ⚡ **20+ fault types** automatically detected
- 📈 **10% higher asset performance** and **8% more portfolio production**
- ⏱️ **4× faster fault resolution** , down to half a day
- 💰 **31% recoverable** and **65% avoidable losses** identified
- 🎯 **100% fault-detection accuracy** achieved within four months
